provenance: Standard-owned deterministic reconstruction of the external runner's previously hidden inputs, normalized to current ClaimReference, IdentityBundle, VerifyResultRef, signed-recipe, production-authority, signature, freshness, and presence-only rules
hashScope: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON with recursively sorted keys; each inputHash covers only that case's evaluations; fileSha256 is pinned by MANIFEST.json

cases.name: dacs1-cci-lei-defect
cases.summary: A cci-lei claim cannot satisfy a distinct bare lei requirement.

cases.name: dacs1-cci-lei-named-matches

cases.name: dacs1-tier-laundering-guard
cases.summary: Another same-scheme pass cannot authorize the exact selected claim.

cases.name: vet-control-existence-only-lei-reputation-key-reject

cases.name: vet-control-key-unresolvable-binding-indeterminate

cases.name: vet-control-key-stale-reject

cases.name: vet-control-key-verified-selector-laundering-reject

cases.name: vet-ma3-resolution-vs-presence

cases.name: vet-ma3-verified-accept

cases.name: vet-findclaim-decision

cases.name: vet-freshness-fail-closed
